integrity: Full certificate source and exact homometry-pair table are embedded in the package. Integer-only exhaustive computation, with independent word/circle canonicalization and window histogram implementations; no probabilistic hashing or external dependencies.

The only general infinite extension proved concerns blocklengths divisible by 12; other lengths are not classified. Unindexed prior equivalent classifications remain possible.
